verdict.rationale: The evidence only states 'Automate tasks with Shortcuts' (macos-docs-19), with no detail on event-based triggers or rule definition. The closest event-driven behavior is Safari Notify Me (macos-docs-34), which watches pages for changes but only alerts the user rather than running user-defined actions. Missing for 10: documented event triggers (e.g., time, file, app, or device events), user-defined rule/condition logic, automatic action execution without manual invocation, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
